project_name: 甜菜红素三酶真实来源计算设计验收
fetched_from: NCBI E-utilities nuccore efetch (official GenBank record)
extraction_policy: Each CDS is extracted exactly from the unique GenBank CDS feature with Biopython SeqFeature.extract(record.seq). No start/stop codon was added, deleted, or replaced. No codon optimization or sequence rewrite was performed.
functional_evidence_boundary: GenBank/DDBJ records provide sequence provenance. Literature supports functional and combination context. This software case is not the paper's original vector and does not assert experimental expression.
manual_review_notes: betalamic acid and cyclo-DOPA 5-O-glucoside subsequently form betanin by a non-enzymatic condensation in this case record; no fourth transcription unit is created.
